legal_terms_acceptance_text: Mu guhita no gukoresha Bigenda Bite, wemera aya Masano yo Gukoresha n'Iyi Politiki y'Ibanga. Nta wemerewe gukoresha serivisi yacu.
legal_terms_use_text: Ushobora gukoresha Bigenda Bite ku buryo bwawe, kugira ngo udakoreshe ibyo byacu. Uemera kutagira gukoresha serivisi, kugira gutegereza guhita ntivugururwa, cyangwa gutera ibibazo mu byo byakora.
legal_terms_content_text: Ibiranga byose kuri Bigenda Bite, harimwo ibyanditswe, imiterere, ingingo, n'ibikorwa by'ubushobozi, birihejwe n'abakoresha cyangwa bishyizwe ku ruhande rwacu. Ntushobora kwemeza kwigura, gushyira mu bikorwa, cyangwa gutera ibyo biri mu gitabo, bidahereye ubuhomye bwacu. Ibyo abakoresha bongereye biri mu rwego rwabo ariko biremwa guhita.
legal_terms_accounts_text: Uri ukugenzura ibanga rya konti yawe n'ibintu byose biba mu konti yawe. Uzigomba kugira amakuru y'ukuri no gushyiraho ibyabaye. Dushobora gushira icyiciro cyangwa gutandukanya konti zigamije aya masano.
legal_terms_submissions_text: Ufite ubushobozi bw'icyo usaba. Mu gishushanya, wemera kugira gufasha, gusangira, no gushyira mu bikorwa ibyo wasabye mu byo byose bya serivisi. Utegereza ko ibyo wasabye ntabibabajwe.
legal_terms_ads_text: Bigenda Bite ishobora gushyira ibishushanisho n'inkuruzanira z'urubuga rw'amafata. Ntibakenewe ibyo biranga, iby'ibanga, cyangwa amasano ya rubuga rw'amafata. Ibintu wakoze n'abashushanishwa biragaba wewe n'ushushanishwa.
legal_terms_payments_text: Abutunzi bw'amafaranga burabwa ku MTN Mobile Money. Amafaranga yose yabaye atabishoboka kuri mu buryo bwa leta. Dushobora guhindura amafaranga tugahagarikiza. Ubutunzi bwo gutanga kurinda gushika mu mwanya wa facture inyuma y'gutandukanya.
legal_terms_disclaimer_text: Bigenda Bite iranyongereye "biyo byanze" n'"biri kugira ngo byikoreshwe" ntacyo ibikenewe. Ntabwo dushobora gushyigikira ko serivisi izaba ikora ntacyo gikomeretse, ibintu byose bimeze neza, cyangwa ko amakuru yose yemewe cyangwa byuzuye. Imirimo ya leta n'amafaranga ashinduka; remeza ku nzira zemejwe.
legal_terms_liability_text: Mu buryo bwose bwo gufasha igihugu, Bigenda Bite n'abakozi bayo ntababigera kubera ibibazo by'amafata, byose byatumye ibibazo by'ubutaka, cyangwa ibibazo by'ibihe bitegurirwa ku gukoresha serivisi. Ubushinzi bwacu bwo hejuru ntibushobora gushika ku gihe wasabye mu myaka 12 ijabaye.
legal_terms_changes_text: Dushobora guhindura aya masano igihe cyose. Impinduka ziragera bivugwa. Gukoresha kurinda inyuma y'impinduka kureba ko wemeje. Tuzababwira abakoresha impinduka by'ingenzi ku imeli cyangwa ku ruhande rw'ikinyamakuru.
legal_terms_contact_text: Niba ufite ibibazo ku bwa masano, andikire legal@bigendabite.com cyangwa ujye ku paji y'ukuntu.
legal_privacy_data_collected_text: Dukusanya amakuru yose ushira imbere n'ibyo bibayeho bigaragara:
legal_privacy_data_account: Amakuru y' Konti: izina, imeli, ijambo banga (ryahishuririye), urubuga, ibyemezo
legal_privacy_data_usage: Amakuru y' Gukoresha: ama paji yabonetse, gushaka, gukoresha, igihe cyabayeho, amakuru y'ikinyabwo n'ubuseruzi
legal_privacy_data_location: Aho waboneka binyuze: nka umugi kuko aderesu y'IP (kugira ngo amakuru agenewe umugi)
legal_privacy_data_device: Amakuru y'ikinyabwo: aderesu y'IP, urwo rwo guserukira, sisitemu y'ubutumwa, uwo wajyaje
legal_privacy_data_cookies: Cookies n'ibindi by'umwanya bwabyo: cookies z'ikinyamakuru, ibyemezo, ibara
legal_privacy_usage_text: Dushyira amakuru kugira ngo dufate serivisi no guhabwa ibyo byagenzwe, gushyira amakuru agenewe umugi, gutangiza ubutumwa, kwishyura amafaranga, gusuzumira nawe, no kubara ibyo byagenzwe. Ntabwo duguza amakuru yawe y'imibereho.
legal_privacy_sharing_text: Dushyira hamwe amakuru n'abo bamwe: abafasha serivisi (gufatanya, ubushobozi, kwishyura) mu masano; abashinzwe nzira z'umutekano biva ku mvo z'umutekano; abashyizemo imbaraga na wemerewe; n'ibyo byose byafashijwe nabi, byose byose.
legal_privacy_ads_text: Dushyira amakuru ajya kubaha ibanga (ntibyo byose by'imibereho). Abashushanishwa b'abandi bashobora gukoresha cookies kugira ngo bakore amahirwe. Ushobora gushira mu buryo bwo gusubira mu buryo bwa browser. Google AdSense ishobora gushyira ibishushanisho by'abakoresha ku buryo bwagenzwe gushaka.
legal_privacy_analytics_text: Dureba ama paji yabonetse, ibintu byaba, n'ibivugwa by'imbaraga kugira ngo duhabwa serivisi. Amakuru yose yemewe nabi bagize ubushobozi bwo gushyira imwe n'imwe. Ushobora guhagarika imibare mu masezerano y'konti.
legal_privacy_security_text: Dushyira imbaraga z'uburezi n'izina z'ibanze kugira ngo dukingire amakuru yawe. Ariko, nta gukorera interineti kugira ngo baba bishingiye 100%. Ijambo ry'ibanga rihishuririye na bcrypt. Ikinyamakuru gikoresha cookies z'HTTP-only.
legal_privacy_rights_text: Ushobora kubona, gushyiraho, gusiba, cyangwa kugabanya amakuru yawe y'imibereho. Ushobora gukana gukoresha cyangwa kwihanga. Andikira privacy@bigendabite.com. Dushobora gusubiza mu nsi 30.
legal_privacy_retention_text: Dukura amakuru y'konti nk'uko konti irakora. Konti zidatandukanye zisibwa inyuma y'amayaka 2. Amakuru y'imibare akurwa imyaka 13. Amakuru y'kwishyura akurwa mu masezerano y'imari.
legal_privacy_children_text: Bigenda Bite ntiyemewe abana bafite imyaka 13 cyangwa afite. Ntibakusanya amakuru y'abana. Nimba wumva ko byabaye, andikira ngo dushyireho.
legal_privacy_changes_text: Dushobora guhabwa iyi politiki. Impinduka ziragerwa hano n'umunsi w'impinduka gushika. Impinduka by'ingenzi zibazwa ku imeli cyangwa ku ruhande rw'ikinyamakuru.
legal_privacy_contact_text: Ibibazo ku bwa politiki? Andikira privacy@bigendabite.com cyangwa ukoreshe paji yacu y'ukuntu.
about_intro: Bigenda Bite ni ubusobanuro bwawe bw'umunsi ku munsi ku buzima n'imirimo ya leta mu Rwanda. Bwubatswe n'ubunyangamutima ku Rwanda, n'abanyarwanda.
about_mission_text: Gushyira amakuru ya leta ahari kugira ngo abanyarwanda bose bakoreshe nta kibazo cyangwa ubuzima bwo gutega. Kugira ngo bose bashobore gutera imbere ibintu byabo nta gusubira inyuma cyangwa ubuzima.
about_team_text: Turi umushami muto wa bahinzi, abanditse, n'abashakashatsi banyarwanda batanga ko amakuru meza ashobora guhindura ubuzima. Dukora n'amakuru ya leta, abatanga ibitekerezo b'abaturage, n'abashingamatsi ba hafi.
about_approach_text: Umurimo wose n'ubusobanuro bwose busuzumwe ku nzira zemejwe. Dushyira imbere ukuri kuruta ubwimbu, n'ubwenge kuruta guhitamo byose. Inama z'abaturage zongeramo uburyo bwo kwigira ry'ukuri rwabwo ibyo by'umutekano ntibyishushanya.
about_content_text: Imirimo ya Leta — Amategeko ya leta n'intambwe, amafaranga, n'inyandiko. Ubusobanuro b'Uburyo — Inama z'uburyo bw'umunsi ku munsi. Uruhande rw'ubucuruzi — Abahinzi ba hafi bemejwe. Imenyabose — Itangazo ry'ingenzi ry'igihe gishobora gukora.
about_tech_text: Bwakozwe na Next.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, na Sanity CMS. Bifashijwe ku Vercel. Kwishyura ku MTN MoMo. Gukorera iby'umutekano bikoresheje abantu n'abashingamatsi bikurikije ibyagenzwe.
about_contact_text: Dushaka kugira ngo dukwizere imbere. Andikira hello@bigendabite.com cyangwa ujye ku paji y'ukuntu.
contact_info_text: Twishimiye gukumena ibyo ufite. Nimba ufite ikibazo, igitekerezo, cyangwa ushaka gusuzuma.
